author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **SelfbotGuard v1.0.0** — advanced selfbot detection & punishment.

Get started: `[p]sbguard enable` to turn it on, `[p]sbguard action <action>` to set punishment.

Detection heuristics: rich-embed abuse, inhuman response speed, timing precision analysis, 24/7 activity profiling, and automated command-response pattern matching.

Cog is *disabled by default* — enable per-server.
name: SelfbotGuard
short: Advanced selfbot detection with configurable per-server punishments.
description: SelfbotGuard v1.0.0 detects Discord selfbots using multiple heuristic layers: rich-embed abuse detection (user accounts cannot send rich embeds via the client), inhuman response-time analysis, message-timing precision scoring, 24/7 activity profiling, automated command-response pattern matching, and rapid-fire burst detection. Each heuristic contributes to a cumulative suspicion score per user. When the score exceeds a configurable threshold, the bot takes action: warn, mute/timeout, kick, ban, or log-only. Admins can configure sensitivity, exempt roles/users, set a dedicated log channel, and review flagged users. Cog is disabled by default per-server.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and guild IDs for selfbot detection. Per-user data includes message timestamps, response timing, activity windows, and suspicion scores. Data is used solely for detection heuristics and is periodically pruned.
